content.text: Now I have all the information I need. Let me update the ticket with the resolution:

input.note:
CAUSE: The PVC `data-ledger-db-0` is stuck in Terminating state because it has the `kubernetes.io/pvc-protection` finalizer attached. This finalizer is part of Kubernetes' Storage Object in Use Protection feature, which prevents PVCs from being deleted while they are actively in use by a Pod [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#storage-object-in-use-protection-0]. The `ledger-db-0` Pod is still Running and actively using this PVC.

EVIDENCE: Pod listing shows ledger-db-0 (status: Running) is using the PVC data-ledger-db-0 (claim_status: Terminating) with the kubernetes.io/pvc-protection finalizer present. The cleanup job logs confirm the PVC was deleted 20+ hours ago but remains stuck in Terminating state waiting for the Pod to release it.

FIX: You must stop the ledger-db-0 Pod before the PVC can be deleted. The PVC will remain protected until no non-terminal Pods are using it [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#storage-object-in-use-protection-0]. You can:

1. Delete the ledger-db-0 StatefulSet or Pod to allow the PVC to be fully deleted
2. Or manually delete only the Pod: `kubectl delete pod ledger-db-0 -n ledger`

Once the Pod is terminated, the `kubernetes.io/pvc-protection` finalizer will automatically be removed and the PVC deletion will complete, allowing your cleanup job to finish.
